en-US.longDescription: Resumable, observable migrations for large S3-compatible object storage. Supports S3-to-S3, local-to-S3, and S3-to-local transfers. Commercial software with a permanent free tier (10 GB/run). 30-day trial (50 GB) available at https://godwit.io — no credit card required. Paid plans from €15/month.
